messages:
naomi: Quick one before we send offers  whats the canonical link we should paste in offer emails for New Hire Orientation? We have folks in BST, IST and AEDT and I dont want to send the ephemeral Meet link by mistake. Also: should we include a one-line blurb about recordings?
onboarding-bot: Event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nh-orient-2026-main. Recording will be attached to the event and a copy uploaded to Drive:/onboarding/recordings within 30 minutes of the session.
hugo: Use the calendar event URL (same as above) as the canonical link. After the session we publish a short bundle (slides + 20m quick-watch + transcript) and a single shortlink. I can create the shortlink and post it here once the assets are processed. Slides are already up: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-2026-decks.
meera: Heads up  some new hires reported that importing the .ics into Outlook created a duplicate event and showed the time incorrectly (host TZ vs local TZ). Can we produce a TZ-fixed .ics or add clear instructions?
tz-helper: Time conversions for the event: 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST / 21:30 IST / 00:00 AEDT (next day). Recommendation: add this exact table to the top of the calendar description and the offer blurb. Also add: "If you accepted via Google Calendar, do NOT import the .ics (it can create duplicates)." We can generate per-region .ics (e.g., ?ctz=Australia/Sydney) on request.
dave: Accessibility note: we auto-generate English captions and an SRT, run transcripts into Notion (New Hire Hub), and produce auto-translated SRTs for common languages. If a manager needs verified human captions (Spanish, Mandarin, Portuguese), DM me names and language and well arrange it for the replay.
naomi: Perfect. Can someone write a short paragraph I can paste in the offer that explains "how to join, what to expect, and where the recording will be"? Keep it friendly/short.
hugo: Draft blurb (feel free to tweak): "Join New Hire Orientation at 09:00 PT via the calendar event link. The session includes a 60
min run (product + infra + security) and 20
mins of Q&A. Slides and recordings (full + 20m quick-watch) will be attached to the calendar event and saved to our onboarding Drive folder within 30 minutes. If you cannot attend live, watch the quick-watch and join the weekly drop-in Q&A. IMPORTANT: If you accepted the invite in Google Calendar, do not import the .ics to avoid duplicate events in Outlook/Apple calendars."
meera: Thanks Hugo  one more: are there breakout rooms? A few hires will be on phones and sometimes get stuck in the waiting room.
dave: Well run two short breakouts (10 mins each) for icebreakers. Mobile clients sometimes force users to a waiting room on breakout; backup plan: well paste the prompts in the main chat and create small Slack huddles for each group. Also we host a weekly drop-in Q&A (Mon 17:00 UTC) for anyone who misses the live session.
onboarding-bot: APAC replay event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nh-orient-apac-2026 at 09:00 AEST on 2026-05-22. Invite sent to new-hires@redwood.com.
naomi: Great  who should I ping after the session to get the shortlink for the slides+quick-watch bundle to insert into the offer packet?
hugo: Ping me @hugo or drop the thread id. Ill post the shortlink within 20-30 minutes after processing.
naomi: Thanks all  Ill paste Hugo's blurb into the offer and tell hiring managers to include the calendar link (not the ephemeral Meet). :thumbsup:
hugo: Appreciate it  LMK if any region needs a TZ-fixed .ics and @tz-helper will generate one.
